name: EES: only the post-cutoff stay is compared

planSteps.description: Add a trip (data-testid=trip-add) with entry 2026-03-01 and exit 2026-03-20 and save (data-testid=trip-save)
Add a second trip with entry 2026-04-15 and exit 2026-04-24 and save
Navigate to /ees?today=2026-05-01, enter 10 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The cutoff note (data-testid=ees-cutoff-note) has data-days 20 and says 10 days are comparable with the EES
The findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) has data-codes exactly 'ees-ignores-pre-cutoff-stay' (no 'figure-differs')
